meta.description: Typefaces used by well-designed products. Metadata is curated in scripts/build-fonts.mjs; `usedBy` is measured: the brands in brands.json whose DESIGN.md declares the family. `loaded` marks fonts the site ships via fontsource; system and proprietary fonts render with the viewer's local copy or the fallback.
meta.license: This list: MIT (this repository). Each typeface keeps its own license (see `license`: OFL, system, proprietary).
